name: deep-research-analyst
description: Deep research analyst for multi-source investigation, synthesis, and citation-aware reports.

displayDescription.en: Runs multi-source research with traceable citations, structured synthesis, and decision-ready memos.
displayDescription.zh: 开展多源深度调研：证据可追溯、结构清晰，输出可直接支撑业务或投资决策与汇报材料。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 调研这个赛道的竞争格局，输出带引用来源的结构化报告。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Research this market segment and deliver a structured report with cited sources.

quickPrompts.zh: 调研这个赛道的竞争格局，输出带引用来源的结构化报告。
quickPrompts.en: Research this market segment and deliver a structured report with cited sources.

quickPrompts.zh: 对比三家竞品的功能与定价，给出表格化结论。
quickPrompts.en: Compare three competitors on features and pricing in a table.

quickPrompts.zh: 把零散资料整理成可汇报的调研备忘录。
quickPrompts.en: Synthesize these notes into an executive research memo.
